title: Intake New World (its own theme, the default for every new Space): snapshot, rules and baseline in docs/design-systems/new-world
detail: New World is NOT a revision of Services (Daniel 2026-11-03): Services is the 'Good work, done right.' theme and keeps the `services` id and its intake untouched. New World is the new mega template and the default theme every new Space starts in, with its own id `new-world`, its own --nw-* tokens and its own design-system folder. Ran docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md on its zip: 90 files snapshotted, rules claim the framework files as built by LIVE-1997, baseline 74 known gaps (64 copy, 10 missing built targets), draft theme.manifest.json (hidden) and role-coverage baseline. Token gaps appear once NEW_WORLD_TOKENS_CSS exists (LIVE-2054). Flag for Daniel: the zip's default neon accent is violet (#8A6AFF, deep #5B42C9); keep Tide until he rules.
